responsibility: This header publishes a miscellaneous C-library wrapper interface for the mc-boot runtime beyond the broader libc bridge. It declares helpers that expose formatted current time text, file size, inode, and modification-time queries from file descriptors, bounded random-number generation, current-user name lookup and user-name to uid/gid resolution, plus math classification helpers such as signbit and non-builtin isfinite variants for float, double, and long double, providing a small procedural façade for host services that generated Modula-2 runtime code needs directly.
